Class FaceppFacesetAsyncOperations

java.lang.Object
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppOperations
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppFacesetOperations
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppFacesetAsyncOperations
public class FaceppFacesetAsyncOperations extends FaceppFacesetOperations
Async-capable operations for FaceSet management, including asynchronous add/remove face operations and task status queries.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)

    • asyncAddFaceWithToken

      public void asyncAddFaceWithToken(String facesetToken, String[] faceTokens, Consumer<FaceAddResponse> consumer) throws IOException
      Asynchronously adds face tokens to a FaceSet identified by its token.
      Parameters:
      facesetToken - the FaceSet identifier
      faceTokens - array of face tokens to add (max 5)
      consumer - callback to receive the response
      Throws:
      IOException - if the HTTP request fails
